learning_objective: 🎯 We will discover the amazing story of Louis Braille and how people who cannot see learn to read!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Louis Braille was a brave boy who lost his eyesight. But he loved books so much that he invented a new way to read using his fingers.
Braille is a special alphabet made of raised dots on paper. People can feel these dots with their fingertips to read words.

fun_activity.title: 😎 Blindfold Mystery
fun_activity.instructions: Wear a blindfold and ask a friend to give you different objects. Try to guess what they are just by touching them!

quick_recap: ⭐ Braille helps visually impaired people to read and write.
⭐ It is made of raised dots that you can feel.
⭐ Louis Braille showed us that we can overcome any problem.
